section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: 13 Distribution of suicides by Age-Groups in States, Union Territories and Cities. Appendix III presents incidence of suicidal deaths in States, Union Territories and cities by three age groups viz. (A) Persons upto 18 years; (B) Persons between 18 years to 30 years and (C) Above 30 years. It has been observed that on an average 42.9% of persons who committed suicides were in the age group of 18 to 30 years. Barring the States of Bihar, all other States conformed to all-India pattern. Among the important cities Bombay deviated significantly from All-India pattern where the percentage of persons in the age group of 18 to 30 years was as high as 62.1.
